output.reason: The only evidence is one changelog line [ev-c5612ed57e07]. It says a null security context was removed from "redis-ha values.yaml" to placate Helm 3.17.1. It does not name the key path, so "redis-ha.securityContext" is a guess. It also does not say whether this values.yaml is something users consume or only an upstream file used to build manifests. It says nothing about which environments are affected. The proposed exposure (users setting the key AND Helm >=3.17.1) has no support either: the removed value was an upstream null default, not something a user set, and every validator was inconclusive. To decide, I would need the actual diff from #22035 (which file and key), whether that file reaches users' Helm values or rendered manifests, and the Helm 3.17.1 failure the fix addresses.
